You’ve got a **2019 Toyota Corolla** with **68,000 km**, and the symptoms point to a brake check being the priority. The message below asks for inspection, possible pad replacement, and weekday availability within your date window.

## Ready-to-Send Booking Message

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clipboard-check.svg

Hello, I’d like to book a service appointment for my **2019 Toyota Corolla** with **68,000 km**.

I’m hearing a **squeaking noise when braking** and have noticed a **slightly longer stopping distance**. Please arrange a **brake inspection** and let me know if **brake pad replacement** is needed.

My budget is **up to AUD 450** if possible. I’m looking for the **earliest available weekday slot** between **Monday 25 May 2026 and Friday 29 May 2026** in **Australia/Melbourne**.

Please reply with your earliest availability, estimated cost, and any additional work you think may be required.
